subject: biology-9
description: Official 12-mark Section A Federal Board half-book exam simulator covering Units 6 to 10 by Lecturer Rubina Ashraf.

questions.question: Which of the following biological proteins performs an insoluble, protective structural role in hair and nails?
questions.explanation: Keratin is an insoluble fibrous structural protein rich in disulfide bridges forming hair, nails, claws, and epidermal skin.

questions.question: Applying Newtonian reaction laws to animal mechanics and gait belongs to which interdisciplinary science?
questions.explanation: Biophysics explores biomechanical forces, torque, pressure, and energy exchange governing locomotion.

questions.question: What primary macromolecular chemical class do all biological enzymes belong to?
questions.explanation: Enzymes are specialized catalytic globular proteins with precise 3D conformations.

questions.question: During aerobic cellular respiration, which metabolic stage produces carbon dioxide gas?
questions.explanation: Decarboxylation occurs during the transition reaction and citric acid (Krebs) cycle within the mitochondrial matrix.

questions.question: Which anatomical structure represents a classic rudimentary vestigial organ in humans?
questions.explanation: The human vermiform appendix is a reduced cecal remnant inherited from herbivorous ancestors with reduced digestive function.

questions.question: What non-covalent bond holds complementary nitrogenous base pairs together across the DNA double helix?
questions.explanation: Two hydrogen bonds link adenine to thymine (A=T), and three hydrogen bonds link guanine to cytosine (G≡C).

questions.question: Which of the following seed components is a nutritive tissue rather than a part of the embryo itself?
questions.explanation: The plant embryo consists of the radicle, plumule, and cotyledon(s); the endosperm is separate triploid nutritive tissue.

questions.question: How do non-competitive inhibitors decrease enzyme activity without competing for the active site?

options.B: Bind to allosteric sites and alter the active site conformation

questions.explanation: Non-competitive inhibitors bind allosterically, inducing conformational changes that prevent substrate conversion.

questions.question: Which vascular plant tissue conducts water and dissolved mineral ions upward under tension?
questions.explanation: Xylem tracheary elements transport sap via cohesive-transpirational pull from roots to aerial organs.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the microscopic micropyle pore in a mature angiosperm seed?

options.A: Imbibing water and admitting oxygen during germination

questions.explanation: The micropyle facilitates water uptake and aeration needed to reactivate embryonic metabolism during germination.

questions.question: At which hierarchical level of biological organization do DNA, RNA, and proteins function?
questions.explanation: Nucleic acids, proteins, and polysaccharides operate at the molecular level of biological organization.

questions.question: In flowering plants (angiosperms), double fertilization uniquely results in the formation of:

options.D: A diploid zygote and a triploid endosperm

questions.explanation: Double fertilization generates a 2n diploid zygote (future plant) and a 3n triploid endosperm nucleus (nutritive reserve).
